assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production pixel-art environment sprite for Pokémon Apocrypha on pokeemerald-expansion. The attached image is a REFERENCE ONLY from HeartGold/SoulSilver; redesign its distinctive Johto shape for classic Gen 3 GBA presentation. One isolated complete object, orthographic top-down three-quarter Pokémon overworld view, south-facing front, no isometric rotated side. Genuine transparent background. No ground plane, scene, labels, grid, framing, extra props or characters. Clean deliberately placed pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, flat limited shades, warm amber highlights and cooler teal shadows. No gradients, antialiasing, texture noise or photorealism. Maximum 15 opaque colors plus transparency. This must remain readable as a tiny in-game tile object, not an elaborate illustration. Show the sprite uniformly enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels; preserve a simple logical pixel grid. Asset: a modest Cherrygrove house. Logical canvas 80 pixels wide by 64 pixels tall, 5 by 4 tiles of 16 pixels. Fill this footprint. Match the reference's distinctive asymmetrical clay-red gabled roof, a small blue skylight in its left slope, warm tan horizontal plaster/timber facade and dark wooden corner posts. Slight weathering suitable for a quiet coastal town a decade later. One teal-blue square front window on right, single closed red-brown front door at bottom centered at logical x40, door 16 pixels wide. Do not include the reference mailbox or flowerbed. Roof occupies upper two-thirds. Bottom facade flat across south side. Visually simplify to authentic GBA pixel scale rather than simply tracing a high-resolution DS render.
